description: dev-kit: a one-line reminder at the start of a session to check the project's setup

hooks.command: echo "dev-kit is on. Before starting code work in a project, look for .claude/dev-kit.json in it: if it's missing or its checked date is over 30 days old, offer the user /dev-kit:check (it audits tests, CI, required checks, auto-merge and CLAUDE.md). Follow the dev-kit practices skill while working."
